ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $O$ is a point on the line $MN$, $\angle MOC=130^\circ$, $OA$ bisects $\angle MOC$, $\angle AOB=90^\circ$. What is the measure of $\angle BOC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle AOB=90^\circ$,\\
$\angle AOC=65^\circ$,\\
$\angle AOB=\angle AOC+\angle BOC$,\\
therefore, $\angle BOC=\angle AOB-\angle AOC=25^\circ$.\\
Hence, $\angle BOC=\boxed{25^\circ}$.
